title: Playing in Longfellow's march band
summary: After leaving Allen's brass band he played in another brass band and recalls marching tunes read from the music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Yeah. Now let's see. Who did you play with after you left Allen's brass then? After they left Allen's brass, I started playing the record brass.

Mm-hm. We put this march up to call Longfellow, 432. Longfellow's march was a real player of the pure. We went to the Shire, you know, everything started playing. La, da. Joy looks, you know what to make there. But no doodle-doodle-doo there, you see. You play what you see there already. The fella said, well, what's the more I see tomorrow? I said, maybe about what? Oh, maybe that man can't really say, I don't think about it. But no man can do. I said, you know what see me now? I'm a very young child. I don't know. Everything, everything.
Since that time. About what time was that?
